paper.title_en: Spin correlations in the $τ$-lepton pair in polarized electron-positron annihilation
paper.abstract_en: Possible anomalous New Physics contributions to dipole and weak dipole moments of the $τ$ lepton rise considerable interest in theoretical and experimental studies of the $τ$-pair production in electron-positron annihilation and in proton-proton collisions at the LHC. In the present paper we discuss and calculate the spin-correlation matrix in the $e^+ e^- \to τ^+ τ^-$, and in general $f \bar{f} \to τ^+ τ^-$ processes, including New Physics contributions to the $γττ$ and $Z ττ$ vertices and longitudinally polarized beams of initial fermions. The $τ$ decays are included as well. This work is an upgrade of our previous studies of the spin correlations in the $ττ$ system produced in the processes with unpolarized initial fermions ($e^- e^+$ and $q\bar{q}$). A corresponding numerical code is developed. Brief information on how to use and configure the MC programs with a new subroutine is also given.
